The driver called to tell me he had arrived but the app showed him being two minutes away.   All-in-all it was a positive experience. The ability to request a specific type of car and a specific pickup time is good as well  (Car/Van or BB/Silverbird).  BB really needs to drop the increased fee for people using the app.  Once they get this app polished, the fee will be the only significant difference between them and Uber.
